name: Grade 6 Literacy - Reading Comprehension

constructFramework.citation: State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT) Literacy Framework, 2024
constructFramework.notes: Three related sub-constructs: literal recall, inference, evaluation. Competencies are added after this model is created.
